scope: Independent final prose/starter/test/solution/quiz review of modules 01-06; no commits; protected diagram lessons read but not edited.

findings.finding: Project opening falsely said learners had already used Animal, Bird and Fish in the inheritance module.
findings.fix: Refer to actual prior locker/ticket examples and introduce the rescue hierarchy as new.

findings.finding: A valid single-string __slots__ declaration was split into characters and rejected.
findings.fix: Normalize a string to a one-item tuple, while still requiring a local declaration, only label storage and no instance dictionary.

findings.finding: The task required delegation to close(), but copying cleanup into __del__ passed the behavioral check.
findings.fix: Add a restored close spy to distinguish delegation from duplicated cleanup without depending on GC timing.

findings.finding: Float and boolean rejection was checked only at the exhausted overdraft boundary, allowing overdraft rejection to mask missing exact-integer validation.
findings.fix: Repeat invalid-amount checks on an account with available balance and overdraft headroom.

findings.finding: An always-rejecting withdrawal override needed qualification after the earlier substitution lesson.
findings.fix: Explain that the shared balance/deposit interfaces remain usable, but funded-withdrawal callers cannot freely substitute a fixed deposit; mention separating locked holdings in larger designs.

module_assessments.01: Class/object distinction, identity, instance vs class state, method receiver, return values, initialization/defaults, mutable-list ownership and class-body scope build in usable order. Examples teach syntax with distinct fixtures; all 12 learners edit incomplete code.
module_assessments.02: Bound methods follow instance methods; function objects and callable factories precede classmethod/staticmethod; explicit property construction precedes decorators, computation, read-only behavior and setters. Local raise explanation supplies needed validation prerequisite.
module_assessments.03: Separate operator exercises provide transfer, with NotImplemented distinguished from exceptions; equality precedes hashing. Immutability shell previews slots and low-level assignment explicitly without asking learners to author them. __del__ is covered by writable delegation plus a timing-independent probe and quiz, not omitted or portrayed as reliable automatic cleanup.
module_assessments.04: Single inheritance and super precede overrides, substitution, composition, slots and multiple inheritance/MRO. The diamond exercise tests alternate sibling orders. One valid-slot-declaration false negative repaired. Protected lesson prose had no required blocker fixes.
module_assessments.05: Hierarchy exercise follows inheritance rather than original outline order. Movement across three classes is one small shared-interface outcome; no need to split into three trivial one-line lessons. Each subsequent starter preserves all prior methods. Fixed a false backward reference.
module_assessments.06: Money units, exact-int policy, boundary behavior, zero-interest handling, service delegation and report formatting are explicit. Cumulative state is intact. Strengthened validation grading and explained fixed-deposit substitution limits.

cross_module_boundaries: 01->02: method calls and self are established before retrieving a bound method.
02->03: returned text, decorators, properties and validation already support special-method tasks.
03->04: inheritance syntax is newly taught; early immutable-key shell labels its later concepts as supplied.
04->05: all hierarchy/composition mechanisms precede the rescue project; incorrect claimed prior animal example repaired.
05->06: first project practices object ownership and composition before banking adds explicit numeric constraints.
06->07: first enum lesson supplies import/base skeleton and explains members/name/value; no banking-only dependency leaks into the new module.

outline_coverage.classes_and_objects: All supplied topics mapped across 01-02, including function attributes, class callability, class body scope, property function/decorator, static methods.
outline_coverage.special_methods: 03 covers __str__, __repr__, __add__, __sub__, __mul__, __rmul__, __eq__, __lt__, __len__, __bool__, __hash__, __call__, __format__, __del__. Not every rich comparison hook is implemented; __lt__ is the scoped ordering exercise and prose states no automatic derivation.
outline_coverage.inheritance: 04 covers single inheritance, object, extended initialization/methods, override, super, slots/subclass slots, multiple inheritance, MRO and cooperative diamond.
outline_coverage.animal_hierarchy_project: 05 builds Animal/Bird/Fish and a composition-based rescue register/report.
outline_coverage.banking_project: 06 includes Account, SavingsAccount, CurrentAccount, FixedDeposit and independently instantiable InterestCalculator.
outline_coverage.outside_assignment: Enums, descriptors, dedicated exceptions, optional ABCs and ecommerce are in 07-10 and not claimed reviewed beyond 07/01 boundary.
